claim.claim-text: 1. A mounting system applied to cabinets with feet comprising the left side (1a) being composed of U-shaped bends (1c) receiving the double tubular rear feet (2a) in square section welded in H-shape on its forward part of the left side (2b) by fitting them to the bends of the side part (1c), being locked by manually bending the tab (1b) on the hole (2c) of the foot.

2. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet according to the claim 1, comprising the right side (4a) composed of U-shaped bends (4c) receiving the double tubular rear feet (2a) in square section welded in H-shape on its forward part of the right side (2b) by fitting them to the bends (4c) of the side part, being locked by manually bending the tab (4b) on the hole (2c) of the foot.

3. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet according to claim 2, comprising the left side (1a) being composed of U-shaped bends (1c) receiving the double tubular front feet (2a) in square section welded in H-shape on its forward part of the left side (2b) by fitting them to the bends of the side part (1c), being locked by manually bending the tab (1h) on the hole (2c) of the foot.

4. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet, according to claim 3, comprising the right side (4a) being composed of U-shaped bends (4c) receiving the double tubular front feet (2a) in square section welded in H-shape on its forward part of the right side (2b) by fitting them to the bends (4c) of the side part, being locked by manually bending the tab (4h) on the hole (2c) of the foot; after locking, the cabinet with feet is placed upright (8).

5. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet according to claim 4, comprising the mounted assembly of the side parts, and rear and front feet (8) receiving the lower part of the back section of the cabinet (9a) by simply fitting it over the U-shaped bend (1c and 4c) and over the rear foot (2a), the assembly being locked by manually bending the tab (9f and 9g) on the holes (1e and 4e) of the left and right sides.

6. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet according to claim 5, comprising the mounted assembly of the side sections, feet and lower part of the back section of the cabinet (11) receiving the upper part of the back section of the cabinet (12a) by simply fitting it over the U-shaped bend (1c and 4c), the assembly being locked by manually bending the tab (12f and 12g) in the holes (1d and 4d) of the left and right sides; still, for fully locking the pieces, the upper part of the back section of the cabinet (12a), by manually bending the tab (12e) on the hole (9e) of the lower part of the back section of the cabinet, (9a) finishes the locking of the pieces.

7. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet, according to claim 6, comprising the base (15) of the cabinet presenting 90° side L-shaped bends (15b and 15c) which are fitted to the 180° bends (1f and 4f) of the left (1a) and right (4a) sides, promoting full locking of the mounted assembly of the left and right sides, rear and front feet, and the lower and upper part of the back section.

8. The mounting system applied to cabinets with feet according to claim 7, comprising the mounted assembly of the side sections, feet, and lower and upper part of the back section of the cabinet, and base (17) receiving the cabinet top (18a) by slidingly fitting the 90° side L-shaped bends followed by the second 180° inverted bend (18b); the sliding occurs in the 180° upper bend (1g and 4g) of the left and right side sections, promoting full positioning on and fitting to the assembly; the top is locked by manually bending the tabs (12h) positioned on the U-shaped bend of the upper part of the back section (12a) which is fitted on the hole (18c), finishing the locking of the cabinet pieces, thus forming the box of the cabinet with feet in order to receive the shelf and the doors (not illustrated).

9. A mounting system for cabinets with feet comprising: a left side panel (1a) comprising a first U-shaped bend (1c) with a first tab (1b) in the bend; and a rear support structure (2a) welded in an H-shape comprising a first tubular foot and a second tubular foot, each foot having a square cross-section and having a hole (2c) in an upper part of the foot (2b); wherein the upper part of the first tubular foot (2b) of the rear support structure is received within the first bend (1c) of the left side panel (1a) such that the hole (2c) in the first tubular foot is aligned with the first tab (1b), and is locked in position by the first tab (1b) being bent into the hole (2c) in the first tubular foot.

11. The mounting system according to claim 10, further comprising: a front support structure welded in an H-shape comprising a first tubular foot and a second tubular foot (2a), each foot having a square cross-section and having a hole (2c) in an upper part of the foot (2b); wherein the left side panel (1a) further comprises a second U-shaped bend (1c) with a third tab (1h) in the bend; and wherein the upper part of the first tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure is received within the second bend (1c) of the left side panel (1a) such that the hole (2c) in the first tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure is aligned with the third tab (1h), and is locked in position by the third tab (1h) being bent into the hole (2c) in the first tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure.

12. The mounting system according to claim 11, wherein: the right side panel (4a) comprising a second U-shaped bend (4c) with a fourth tab (4h) in the bend; and wherein the upper part of the second tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure is received within the second bend (4c) of the right side panel (4a) such that the hole (2c) in the second tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure is aligned with the fourth tab (4h), and is locked in position by the fourth tab (4h) being bent into the hole (2c) in the second tubular foot (2b) of the front support structure.
